scenarios.name: Enable a preceding panel while an expansion is open

scenario_steps.name: the full 3D Model ribbon is docked at the top
Primitives is hidden and Create and Modify are visible
the Modify additional command area is open and unpinned
the user opens the panel selector and selects Primitives
Primitives is checked and appears before Create
Modify and its open additional command area shift to the right
the user clears Primitives in the panel selector
Primitives is unchecked and its panel disappears
Modify and its open additional command area return to their earlier position
